description: Step 5.3 decisions, made one by one by the user. Applied by 053_apply_decisions.py.
format_choices_approved_by_user: Trailing wildcards are removed (428.xx is 428, meaning every code under 428), and wildcards in the middle of a code become the valid codes (410.X0 is 41000, 41010 ... 41090).
Ranges side by side are joined (410-414 and 415-417 are 410-417).
Codes described in words are written as a range (codes beginning with "I" is I00-I99).
BMJ 2024's composite, described as the union of seven subtypes, takes the combined codes of those seven subtypes.
Markers use the 2022 CCW (the cited document), CCS 2015 (the last ICD-9 edition) and CCSR v2023.1 (a recent version).
Where a paper does not state the diagnosis position, Step 5.1 assigns principal diagnosis, or the first 10 fields for conditions often recorded as secondary, and notes it.
coverage_cutoff: Very low coverage means 50% or below, including 50%, in either direction. Set by the user.
